scenes: Meet Abu Salim. His date palms have stood on this farm for forty years.
Another season... and still no dates.
I cut them down. But now what? I can't sell them, and I can't just burn them.
Heavy trunks, and nowhere to go.
Salaam, Abu Salim! Leave those trunks to us.
ARIBS collects them, right from his farm.
At our factory in Barka, palm trunks go in... and natural palm peat comes out.
Packed in sealed two-hundred-litre bags, or supplied loose, by the kilo or the ton.
Abu Salim! Remember your old palms? They're back!
Mixed into the soil, palm peat holds water longer, so every drop goes further.
Look at this! Tomatoes, peppers... my farm is alive again.
From burden to better soil. ARIBS, helping make Oman greener, one palm at a time.
